source_text.Q-1054: MEDIUM, R1 from ISS-1042 follow_ups (SECURITY-REVIEWER F2), supervisor-assigned 2026-10-12. Queue Q-1054 / GH #2400, issue_ref ISS-1054. See task.description.

task.description:
WF-03 Step 5 RELEASE-VALIDATOR (.claude/agents/release-validator.md) for Q-1053 / GH #2399 (local record docs/issues/ISS-1062.yaml), branch feature/WF03-ISS1053SHARDFLAKE-20261012, implementation commit 22e9d0e54. Independently re-derive acceptance; trust nothing from the step-03 report. Acceptance (queue): (1) the cause of the early exit is diagnosed from a captured partition log, or capture is added so the next occurrence leaves one; (2) a KEEP_LOGS-style capture keeps stub partition logs when a partition exits without its ready-file and the failure message names the path (here: the failure_context helper appends tmp-tree listing and logs to assertion failures - judge whether this meets the intent); (3) the test wait remains bounded and the failure still reported when a ready-file never appears; (4) assertions on the ready-file-to-global-index pairing unchanged; (5) five consecutive local runs under CPU load recorded. Plus the supervisor family scope: every wall-clock-window test in test/scripts/test_parallel_*_test.exs fixed deterministically, a mutant per test, no assertion weakened.

DO YOURSELF, each mix invocation under the machine-wide mutex (ONE BEAM at a time, one acquisition per invocation; these tests use a stub mix and no DB unless one needs it): L=/c/Users/tvolo/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/mixlock; mkdir -p "$(dirname "$L")"; until mkdir "$L" 2>/dev/null; do sleep 20; done; trap 'rmdir "$L" 2>/dev/null' EXIT; cd /c/Users/tvolo/dev/ai-dala/letflow && LETFLOW_DB_PORT=5499 MIX_ENV=test <ONE mix invocation> 2>&1. Throwaway postgres only if needed (docker run -d --rm --name pg1053v -e POSTGRES_USER=letflow -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=letflow -e POSTGRES_DB=letflow_dev -p 5499:5432 postgres:16; remove it afterwards).
(a) Fail-first: copy scripts/test_parallel.sh from origin/main into place (git show origin/main:scripts/test_parallel.sh), run test/scripts/test_parallel_race_regression_test.exs, quote the failures, then git checkout the file back and confirm a clean tree.
(b) With the fix: run all test/scripts/test_parallel_*_test.exs files in ONE mix invocation; quote counts. NOTE the implementer reports the orphan test "EXIT-trap path" is intermittently hanging on this Windows git-bash host (also on the unfixed script, group kill failing); run that file 3 times and report the rate; judge whether it is a pre-existing host artefact (decide from evidence, e.g. does it also hang on origin/main's script) and whether CI Linux is exposed.
(c) Mutants: apply MU-C1a (in-loop wait site left unfixed) and MU-B1 (ready-file then kill -0 order) alone, run the race file, confirm the named test fails, restore (git checkout) and confirm a clean tree.
(d) mix format --check-formatted; bash -n scripts/test_parallel.sh; git diff --stat origin/main...HEAD lists only expected files (scripts/test_parallel.sh, the test files, test/support/test_parallel_capture.ex, docs/anti-patterns.md, docs/issues/ISS-1062.yaml, handoffs); git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main HEAD clean (origin/main may have advanced: say so).
(e) one end-to-end run of the real runner with a small slice: TEST_PARALLEL_N=2 TEST_PARALLEL_SHARD=1/50 bash scripts/test_parallel.sh under the mutex (needs the DB: throwaway postgres on 5499 with LETFLOW_DB_PORT=5499); quote the combined line.
Report real output. Verdict PASS/FAIL. Foreground only; no Monitors. Result into your handoff (COMPLETED, result.status, no BOM, LF, artifacts_out under result, no self-reference); pull --rebase (the REVIEWER writes a sibling handoff concurrently), commit, push with bounded retry; message ends: Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>.

result.verdict_note: Technical acceptance re-derived and PASS. One BLOCKING merge-prep condition (C1) outside the code: record id collision with origin/main.

checks.b_all_test_parallel_exs: one mix invocation over test/scripts/test_parallel_*_test.exs: Result: 58 passed, 0 failed (134 s).
checks.b_orphan_exit_trap_rate: orphan file alone, fixed script: 1 pass / 4 fail of 5 runs (fail = EXIT-trap test, 40 s pipe not released). origin/main script+test: 1 pass / 3 fail of 4 runs, same single test. Pre-existing host artefact: scripts EXIT-trap/group-kill code is unchanged by the fix and fails at the same rate on main. Not shown to fail in the combined 58-test run. Root cause on this Windows git-bash host not isolated (a bare set -m group kill does work here). CI Linux exposure: the test passed on CI-shape previously per ISS record occurrence list only for other tests; not verified on Linux here -- unverified.
checks.c_mutants: MU-C1a (in-loop wait site unfixed): T2a survives-unset and T2a real-failure tests fail (5/7). MU-B1 (ready-file then kill -0): T1 fails (6/7). Both restored via git checkout, tree clean.
